chunks: Keep away from the Fire prepared for the infidels;
ai.seo_question: What is the Fire prepared for the infidels?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the reality of the Hereafter as a direct consequence of rejecting divine guidance, linking the preparation of Hellfire to the specific state of *kufr* (disbelief) rather than mere ignorance. It serves as a pivotal reminder for believers to cultivate *taqwa* not only to avoid punishment but to align their actions with the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt, ensuring their entry into Paradise.
